column1: # Second readings of HSK words, each its own word with its own card. HSK 3.0 lists a
# polyphone once per reading; the source merges them under one character, so without this
# 长 would only ever be cháng, never zhǎng, "to grow".
# Hanzi, the reading, then its headline, tab separated. The word takes the level and rank of
# the character's main reading, and that reading's senses from the dictionary, the headline
# first as in headlines.tsv. Only readings a learner meets as everyday words are listed:
# not archaic ones, surnames, or a neutral-tone form of the same word.
# Drafted 2026-09-28 for HSK 1 to 4 and reviewed by a native speaker the same day. She
# dropped 过 guo, the neutral tone guò takes in a sentence rather than a word of its own,
# and left 着 zhuó out as formal. HSK 5's were drafted and reviewed 2026-09-29.
